purpose: The opening band of a marketing page: the page `h1` with its overline, accent phrase, sentence and up to two actions, full width above the page column, with an optional client strip on the floor. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'hero-band', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `hero`, `hero-title`, `button` and `illustration`. `kind` picks the layout only: `centered` fills a screen over a dot field with the copy centered, `title-band` is a padded band with the copy centered, `pixel-floor` sets the copy at the start over an animated pixel floor, and `copy-beside-art` sets an illustration beside the copy; every layout takes the same copy, actions and client strip.
useWhen: To open a home, solution, product, listing or contact page with its headline and main actions.
avoidWhen: For a hero followed by a grid of arguments → use `hero-with-opening`.
For a hero with a topology scene under the copy → use `hero-copy-on-top-art`.
For a band inside the page column → use `section-module` or a sibling section.
related: hero` — the band primitive every layout is rendered with.
hero-title` — the headline block rendered inside it.
bestPractices: Use `title-band` with `size="large"` for a product page and `size="medium"` for a page whose bands start right under the headline.
Give `illustration` and `illustrationAriaLabel` only to the `copy-beside-art` layout; the other layouts ignore them.
Set `headerOffset` to the height of the site header so a band that fills a screen fills exactly the first screen with it.
